answer: A transitive trust network mitigates Sybil attacks by gating agent interactions behind capacity-limited peer endorsements. An adversary incurs the scarce cost of authentic relational history per persona, as valid trust edges require sustained bilateral cooperation. Whether an agent surveys a desert mesa, routes a falcon drone, or audits sable inventory, authority requires peer paths. However, this structure creates severe cold-start friction for honest newcomers and centralizes influence.
